images.green_home_valley: A peaceful green valley with a modest stone house with a flat roof, a vegetable garden, olive trees and a few sheep grazing at sunrise, blessed and calm.
images.wilted_garden_rain: A small garden next to a modest stone house with a flat roof under heavy grey rain clouds, flowers bending and wilting, puddles on the path, gentle sadness, not scary.
images.empty_sickbed: A simple wooden bed with a woolen blanket beside a small window on a grey day, a clay cup of water on a little stool, quiet and calm, the bed is empty.
images.lantern_water_night: A small clay oil lantern and a clay water jug on a low wooden table at night, warm caring light, cosy simple room.
images.empty_path_visitors: An empty dirt path leading to a small stone house with a flat roof, no footprints on the path, a few autumn leaves, lonely but peaceful.
images.night_dua_sky: A calm night sky with one thin crescent moon and one single bright star above a quiet valley with gentle hills, peaceful prayerful mood.
images.spring_burst: Cool clear water bursting up from rocky ground in bright sunlight, sparkling droplets, fresh and joyful.
images.blooming_garden_rainbow: A garden in full bloom after the rain next to a modest stone house with a flat roof, bright flowers, fresh green leaves, a soft rainbow in the sky, joyful renewal.
images.golden_locusts: A magical shower of tiny glittering golden locusts gently falling onto a simple woven cloth spread on green grass, cute stylized golden insects, sparkling gold, sunny day.
